<translate>
The '''Capsule Corp Assistant''' is a custom villager profession, often called the "CC-Villager". Besides trading, it works as a '''structure locator''': for a price it sells filled treasure maps that lead to the landmarks of [[Special:MyLanguage/Earth|Earth]], from Goku's House to Majin Buu's House.
</translate>

<translate>
== Finding one ==

Its house generates in '''plains villages''' on Earth. Its job site block is the '''Fuel Generator''': any unemployed villager can take the job by claiming one, so you can also create your own assistant.
</translate>

<translate>
== Treasure maps ==

The maps unlock across its five trade tiers. Every map also costs an empty Map, and each map trade can be used up to 8 times.
</translate>
{| class="wikitable"
! <translate>Tier</translate> !! <translate>Map to</translate> !! <translate>Cost</translate>
|-
| 1 || <translate>Goku's House</translate> || <translate>10 Cooked Dino Meat</translate>
|-
| 1 || <translate>Roshi's House</translate> || <translate>8 Cod</translate>
|-
| 2 || <translate>Piccolo's House</translate> || <translate>1 Water Bucket</translate>
|-
| 2 || <translate>Yamcha's House</translate> || <translate>1 Bone</translate>
|-
| 3 || <translate>Kami's Lookout</translate> || <translate>1 Spruce Sapling</translate>
|-
| 3 || <translate>Fortuneteller Baba's Palace (always offered)</translate> || <translate>6 Glass Bottles</translate>
|-

|-

|-

|-

|-

|-
| 5 || <translate>Majin Buu's House (always offered)</translate> || <translate>1 Cake</translate>
|}

<translate>
The [[Special:MyLanguage/Fortuneteller Baba's Palace|Baba's Palace]] map is offered by every assistant of tier 3 or higher and the '''Buu's House''' map by every tier-5 assistant. They are added the next time you open its trades, so assistants that levelled up before also get them.

Every map points at the nearest structure of its kind with a red X. If that structure hasn't been placed in the world yet, the trade shows as '''out of stock''' and turns into a real map once the structure can be located; re-open the trade window to check again.
</translate>
